column1: # MODE: PROD
# Prebuilt interactive-shell rust binaries shipped with the skill (PTY wrapper
# + socket input client).
# Built by the release/CI (cargo build --release --workspace); never committed.
# Two of the crate's three binaries ship. interactive-shell-fixture is a
# maintainer-only build (its markers say so) because it emits deliberately
# fragmented CSI and OSC sequences as an input to tests/protocol.rs and has no
# use on a target machine, so it stays out of this registry. Its marker words
# are described rather than quoted here: a release gate greps the first 25
# lines of every shipped file for a maintainer marker, and a comment shaped
# like one reads as one.
# No Windows row, unlike chat: the wrapper is POSIX-only by construction. It
# allocates the PTY through libc (TIOCSCTTY, TIOCSWINSZ), terminates a child
# process group with SIGTERM/SIGKILL, and the input client speaks
# std::os::unix::net::UnixStream. x86_64-pc-windows-msvc does not compile, so
# declaring a row would promise an artifact the release can never produce.
